title: derris ovalifolia
intro: Derris ovalifolia, commonly known as Derris, is a tropical legume plant belonging to the family Leguminosae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate fever, reduce pain, and treat infections. The therapeutic actions of Derris ovalifolia include its ability to act as an analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Derris ovalifolia include rotenone, a toxic compound with insecticidal properties, as well as other alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
